response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse experience across architectures and languages, with clear leadership in project development and mentoring — but lacks documented German proficiency (only 'Basic'), executive leadership experience, and explicit UML/architecture design credentials, which are critical for this senior tech lead role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across multiple languages and environments (DLang, Node, TypeScript, Linux)
Demonstrated mentorship and workshop leadership in testing, CI/CD, and web internals
concerns: German language proficiency listed as 'Basic' — fails C1 requirement
No explicit evidence of architectural design, UML modeling, or formal project management experience
Lacks documented executive-level leadership or team management beyond technical contribution
